N° 07Content operations tool2026

Uplink Post Kit

Where every post is drafted, reviewed, scheduled and marked posted.

Visit uplink-posts.floot.app, public view →How to use itWatch the purpose

I

Purpose

A factory floor for daily publishing: every carousel and video arrives as a draft, I review it on my phone, approve it or ask for a change, then post it in two taps.

II

The problem

Content made in a chat gets lost in the chat, and scheduling in three apps means three different truths.

III

What I built

A queue with scheduled times, previews and a status per post. Buttons that copy the right caption per platform and open the phone share sheet. A view for daily talking to camera scripts, a view for live shows with a full run of show, a view that turns saved videos into lessons, and a playbook distilled from them.

IV

How it works

Drafts are inserted straight into the database, media lives on a CDN, and the page remembers the last view. The private link carries a key once per browser; without it the kit is read only, which is the public link.

V

Craft

Forest green and lemon, a serif for dates like a diary, cards that read at arm's length.

VI

The purpose, in motion

A short motion design made for this book: four beats, one drawn shape each, the reason the project exists. Tap it to step through.
